import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svdvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)

np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=180)
print("Keys and shapes:", [(k, v.shape) for k, v in sorted(W.items())])

for l in range(4):
    print("\nLAYER", l)
    for name in ("ln1_w", "ln1_b", "ln2_w", "ln2_b"):
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(float)
        print(name, "min/mean/max/std/norm",
              np.array([a.min(), a.mean(), a.max(), a.std(), np.linalg.norm(a)]))
    for name in ("W_q", "W_k", "W_v", "W_o", "W_fc", "W_proj"):
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(float)
        s = svdvals(a)
        print(name, "Frob", round(np.linalg.norm(a), 4),
              "sv_top12", s[:12], "sv_quantiles", np.quantile(s, [0, .25, .5, .75, 1]))
    g = W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    b = W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
    for j in range(6):
        sl = slice(64*j, 64*(j+1))
        q = W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
        k = W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
        v = W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)
        o = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:, sl].astype(float)
        qg, kg = q*g, k*g
        qg -= qg.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        kg -= kg.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        m = qg.T @ kg / 8
        ov = o @ v
        sm, so = svdvals(m), svdvals(ov)
        eig = np.linalg.eigvalsh((m+m.T)/2)
        kb = kg.T @ (q @ b) / 8
        qb = qg.T @ (k @ b) / 8
        print(f"L{l}H{j}",
              "q/k/v/o_norm", np.round([np.linalg.norm(t) for t in (q,k,v,o)], 3),
              "QK_sv", sm[:8],
              "QK_sym_extremes", eig[[0,1,2,-3,-2,-1]],
              "QK_trace", round(np.trace(m),4),
              "QK_asym", round(np.linalg.norm(m-m.T)/(2*np.linalg.norm(m)),4),
              "bias_key/query_norm", np.round([np.linalg.norm(kb), np.linalg.norm(qb)],4),
              "OV_sv", so[:6],
              "OV_trace", round(np.trace(ov),4))
